text: Function retention: Retain every runtime function affected by labeled blocks sharing enclosing brackets.
Metric retention: Retain those functions’ metrics.
Annotation function retention: Retain every runtime function affected by type annotations sharing enclosing brackets.
Annotation metric retention: Retain those functions’ metrics.
Ownership: Correct the distinction between runtime-label ownership and type-annotation ownership.
Termination: Correct annotation termination at enclosing runtime delimiters.
Replay: Correct replay of enclosing runtime delimiters to their runtime reader.
Field investigation: Investigate related function-type class-field cases.
Assertion investigation: Investigate related object-type assertion cases.
Related corrections: Correct confirmed failures within the same ownership concept.
Label interpretation: Treat a runtime labeled statement as runtime syntax.
Label continuation: Preserve later decisions within the labeled runtime block.
Statement continuation: Preserve later statements within that block.
Runtime closure: Close the block at its actual runtime brace.
Brace boundary: Prevent annotations from swallowing an unmatched enclosing-runtime `}`.
Bracket boundary: Prevent annotations from swallowing an unmatched enclosing-runtime `]`.
Comma boundary: Prevent annotations from swallowing an unmatched enclosing-runtime `,`.
Type brackets: Preserve legitimate nested type brackets.
Type commas: Preserve legitimate nested type commas.
Type arrows: Preserve legitimate function-type arrows.
Signatures: Preserve valid signatures.
Defaults: Preserve valid defaults.
Ternaries: Preserve valid ternaries.
Templates: Preserve valid templates.
Extension metrics: Preserve established extension metrics.
CLI output: Preserve established CLI output.
Earlier fixes: Preserve all previously fixed #524 examples.
Original examples: Preserve established behavior for the six original issue examples.
Authored PR examples: Preserve established behavior for all eleven authored PR #525 examples.
Suffixes: Preserve established behavior across the seven JS-family suffixes.
NS: Preserve established NS behavior.
Nonstrict: Preserve established nonstrict behavior.
CSV: Preserve established CSV-consumer behavior.
Output option: Preserve established `-o`-consumer behavior.
HTTP: Preserve established HTTP-consumer behavior.
Regression proof: Add discriminating regression tests.
Refactoring: Independently refactor the aggregate change.
API performance: Qualify affected API consumers.
Parameter performance: Qualify affected parameter consumers.
Extension performance: Qualify affected extension consumers.
CLI performance: Qualify broad CLI performance.
Pytest: Run the full pytest suite successfully.
Make: Run the full make checks successfully.
Observation retention: Retain failed observations.
Timing retention: Retain immutable timing inputs.
Public meanings: Preserve public metric meanings.
Working tree: Preserve unrelated working-tree changes.
Performance threshold: Each required performance qualification must satisfy a strict paired 95% upper slowdown bound below 3%; equality does not satisfy “below.”
Related-case scope: Field/assertion corrections are conditional on confirming failures that exercise the same ownership responsibility.
Ownership uncertainty: Determine the smallest existing reader/signature owners that distinguish runtime labels and own nested type syntax.
Investigation order: Confirm the exact related field/assertion failures before choosing their implementation.
Authority: The human explicitly authorizes implementation.
Publication authority: The human explicitly authorizes publication.
Minimal labeled-block example: `const x = [() => { a: 1 }];` must report one anonymous function.
Minimal-example location: That function must be reported at line 1.
Reference behavior: The minimal example must match the stated 1.24.1 behavior; the source reports zero functions on master `da29d5d`.
Successor name: A following function retains its own name.
Successor formals: A following function retains its own formals.
Successor span: A following function retains its own span.
Successor complexity: A following function retains its own CCN.
Field-to-constructor journey: A function-type class field preserves a following constructor when it exercises the shared ownership responsibility.
Field-to-method journey: A function-type class field preserves a following method under that qualification.
Assertion-to-arrow journey: An object-type assertion preserves expression-arrow boundaries under that qualification.
Assertion-to-successor journey: An object-type assertion preserves successor boundaries under that qualification.
Example reach: These examples demonstrate required behavior; they do not restrict the promise to only those spellings, delimiters, or successor forms.
Counter exclusion: Do not introduce a parallel runtime bracket counter.
Buffer exclusion: Do not introduce a whole-stream buffer.
Switch exclusion: Do not introduce an issue-specific switch.
